title: Relative Frequency Explained Simply | Statistics for Beginners
desc:
What is relative frequency? Learn to turn a count into a share or percentage of the whole group, so groups of different sizes compare fairly.

In this lesson:
0:00 Is three customers a lot?
0:31 Shares of a bar
0:58 Writing shares as percents
1:45 Count divided by total
3:25 Comparing two groups
3:55 Trap: always check the total

Lesson 1.2.2 of a free, complete data science course for beginners, no maths background needed: statistics, probability, machine learning, deep learning and large language models, one small step at a time, with clear animations and everyday examples.
